description: This file defines the Cart class within the Opencart system, handling shopping cart operations such as adding, updating, removing products, calculating totals, taxes, weight, and managing product options, discounts, subscriptions, and stock status.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents the shopping cart, managing products, options, discounts, subscriptions, and calculations related to the cart's contents.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products in the cart, including detailed options, discounts, subscriptions, and stock status.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart with specified options, quantity, subscription plan, and overrides.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item identified by cart_id.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cart item exists by cart_id.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cart item by cart_id.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription products in the cart.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates the total weight of shippable products in the cart.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal price of all products in the cart.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Calculates applicable taxes for products in the cart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price including taxes for the cart.

methods.name: countProducts
methods.description: Counts total quantity of products in the cart.

methods.name: hasProducts
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains any products.

methods.name: hasSubscription
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains any subscription products.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Checks if all products in the cart are in stock.

methods.name: hasMinimum
methods.description: Checks if all products meet minimum order quantities.

methods.name: hasShipping
methods.description: Checks if any product requires shipping.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Checks if any product has downloadable content.
